items.exampleEn: Strong winds are a threat to the old trees.
items.exampleZh: 強風對老樹是一種威脅。

items.exampleEn: The city is dealing with a water crisis.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市正在處理缺水危機。

items.exampleEn: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.

items.exampleEn: Your idea will be the basis for our new plan.

items.exampleEn: Everyone in the team contributed good ideas.

items.exampleEn: There is a time limit of thirty minutes for the test.

items.exampleEn: Our team made little progress in today's meeting.

items.exampleEn: The storm caused some damage to the roof.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了一些損壞。

items.sentenceEn: Please limit your talk to five minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 請把你的發言限制在五分鐘以內。

items.audioEn: Work on the new library is making good progress, and it will open in May.

items.questionZh: 新圖書館什麼時候開放？

items.sentenceZh: 我們開始使用這個系統後，出現了新的問題。

items.sentenceEn: Hot water can damage this kind of shirt.

items.stemEn: Rising prices are a big ____ to small shops.
items.stemZh: 物價上漲對小商店是很大的威脅。

items.stemEn: Good teamwork ____ to the success of the event.
items.stemZh: 良好的團隊合作促成了這次活動的成功。

items.passageEn: Last year, our neighborhood cafe faced a crisis. A new chain store opened nearby and became a real threat. Sales dropped slightly every month, and the owner had to limit the opening hours. Then an idea emerged: the cafe would hold free music nights on a weekly basis. Local musicians contributed their time, and customers came back. Progress was slow at first, but the cafe soon recovered from the damage. Today, the cafe is busier than ever.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們這一帶的咖啡店遇到了危機。附近開了一家新的連鎖店，成了真正的威脅。營業額每個月都小幅下滑，老闆只好縮短營業時間。後來大家想出了一個點子：咖啡店每週舉辦免費音樂之夜。當地音樂人貢獻了他們的時間，客人也回來了。一開始進展很慢，但咖啡店很快就從損失中恢復了。現在，這家咖啡店比以前更忙了。

questions.questionZh: 咖啡店的危機是怎麼來的？
咖啡店想出了什麼辦法？
options: 搬到人比較多的新地點

referenceEn: He has made fast progress in English.
He is making quick progress in English.
rubricZh: progress 是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s（例如 make progress）
可用 make fast progress、make quick progress 等
寫 His English has improved quickly. 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 limit 造一個句子，說說你會限制自己做的某件事。
referenceEn: I limit my phone time to one hour a day.
I try to limit my coffee to two cups a day.
rubricZh: limit 當動詞「限制」，常用 limit A to B（例如 limit my phone time to one hour）
說的是自己的習慣（主詞用 I）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
